urgent.heading: Okuphuthumayo — sebenzisa i-EpiPen manje
urgent.primary_message: Sebenzisa i-adrenaline auto-injector (EpiPen) ngokushesha ungene ethangeni elingaphandle. Bese ushayela ku-10177.
red_flags: Ukuvuvukala kobuso, izindebe, ulimi, noma umphimbo
Ukuphefumula kanzima, ukuphefumula, noma umphimbo oqinile
Ukuqubuka okungazelelwe noma ama-welts abomvu asakazeka emzimbeni
Ukushaya kwenhliziyo okusheshayo, isiyezi, noma ukuquleka
Ukuhlanza, amajaqamba esiswini, noma isifo sohudo kungazelelwe

what_is_it.heading: I-anaphylaxis ngamazwi alula
what_is_it.lede: I-anaphylaxis iwukungezwani komzimba okunzima, wonke okungaba yingozi phakathi nemizuzu uma ingelashwa.
paragraphs: Kwenzeka lapho isistimu yokuvikela yomzimba isabela ngokweqile kukhinto evame ukungabi yingozi — ukudla, ukulunywa, umuthi, noma i-latex. Imithambo yegazi iyavuza, imigudu yokuphefumula ivuvukale, umfutho wegazi uyehla.

I-Adrenaline (i-epinephrine) ukuphela kokwelashwa komugqa wokuqala. I-auto-injector efana ne-EpiPen iyiletha emsipha wethanga. Ama-Antihistamine nama-inhalers awathathi indawo. Ngemva kokusebenzisa i-EpiPen, umuntu usadinga ukunakekelwa esibhedlela ngoba izimpawu zingabuya ngemva kwamahora ambalwa.

items.headline: Amaminithi
items.body: I-anaphylaxis enamandla ingabulala phakathi nemizuzu engu-15. Ijubane lokwelashwa liyikho konke.

items.headline: Izibangeli eziphezulu
items.body: Amantongomane, amantongomane esihlahla, igobolondo, inhlanzi, ubisi, amaqanda, izinyosi noma iminyovu, imithi (ngokuvamile elwa namagciwane), kanye ne-latex.

items.headline: Igagasi lesibili
items.body: Kufika kumuntu oyedwa kwabangu-5 ukusabela okwesibili ngemva kwamahora angu-4-12, ngisho nangemva kokuba ngcono. Ukubhekwa esibhedlela kubalulekile.

items.headline: EpiPen kuqala
items.body: Umjovo we-Adrenaline auto-injector ukuphela komugqa wokuqala. Kuphephile ukuyisebenzisa - ukuyigodla yikho okudala ukulimala.

pull_quote.text: Uma ungaqiniseki ukuthi i-anaphylaxis — sebenzisa i-EpiPen noma kunjalo. Ingozi yokuyisebenzisa ngokungadingekile incane. Ingozi yokungayisebenzisi ingaba yingozi.

signs.heading: Ongase ukubone
signs.lede: I-anaphylaxis ngokuvamile iqala phakathi nemizuzu yokuchayeka. Izimpawu zihlanganisa isistimu yomzimba engaphezu kweyodwa - isikhumba, ukuphefumula, ukujikeleza kwegazi, noma amathumbu.

items.title: Isikhumba
items.description: Ama-Hives noma ama-welts abomvu, ukulunywa okukhulu, ukushaywa umoya, ukuvuvukala kobuso, izindebe, ulimi, noma amehlo.

items.title: Ukuphefumula
items.description: Ukuhefuzela, umphimbo oqinile, izwi eliyisihosha, ubunzima bokugwinya, ukukhwehlela okungapheli, ukuphefumula kanzima.

items.title: Ukujikeleza
items.description: Ukushaya kwenhliziyo okusheshayo, umfutho wegazi ophansi, isiyezi, ukuquleka, isikhumba esiphaphathekile noma esihlabayo, siyawa.

items.title: Amathumbu kanye jikelele
items.description: Ubuhlungu besisu, ukuhlanza, isifo sohudo kungazelelwe. Umuzwa wokulahlwa uphawu oluqashelwayo oluyisixwayiso.

items.fact: Ama-Antihistamine aphatha izimpawu zokungezwani komzimba okuncane. Abakwazi ukuhlehlisa i-anaphylaxis. I-Adrenaline ukuphela kokwelashwa komugqa wokuqala.

items.myth: Kufanele ngilinde futhi ngibone ukuthi kuya kuba kubi ngaphambi kokusebenzisa i-EpiPen.
items.fact: Yisebenzise ngokushesha lapho kusolwa i-anaphylaxis. Ukubambezeleka kuyimbangela yokufa evame kakhulu. I-Adrenaline iphephile — ukuyigodla kuyingozi.

items.myth: Uma bezizwa bengcono ngemva kwe-EpiPen, akudingeki baye esibhedlela.
items.fact: Basadinga ukubhekwa esibhedlela. Izimpawu zingabuya ngemuva kwamahora (i-biphasic reaction). I-EpiPen yesibili ingase idingeke.

items.myth: Udinga kuphela i-EpiPen uma uke waba nokusabela okunzima ngaphambili.
items.fact: Ukusabela okubi kokuqala kungafika ngaphandle kwesixwayiso, ikakhulukazi kubantu abanokudla okwaziwayo noma ukungezwani nezinambuzane. Khuluma nodokotela mayelana nokuthola i-EpiPen.

items.title: Sebenzisa i-EpiPen ethangeni elingaphandle
items.description: Ngezingubo kuhle. Bamba uqine imizuzwana eyi-10. Qaphela isikhathi osisebenzisile.

items.title: Shayela ku-10177 noma ku-112 ngokushesha
items.description: Ithi 'anaphylaxis'. Ngisho noma umuntu ebonakala engcono, udinga ukubhekwa esibhedlela.

items.title: Zibeke phansi, ziphakamise imilenze yazo
items.description: Isiza umfutho wegazi. Uma zihlanza, zilalise ngohlangothi. Uma ukuphefumula kunzima, mabahlale phansi - bangalokothi bame.

items.title: I-EpiPen yesibili uma kungekho ngcono emizuzwini emi-5
items.description: Nika umthamo wesibili kwelinye ithanga. Iningi lama-EpiPen liza ngamaphekhi angu-2 ngenxa yalesi sizathu.

items.title: Hlala nabo kuze kufike abezimo eziphuthumayo
items.description: Buka ukuphefumula nokushaya kwenhliziyo. Lungela ukwenza i-CPR. Nikeza abezimo eziphuthumayo i-EpiPen esetshenzisiwe.

get_help.heading: Ubani okumele ashayele khona manje
get_help.lede: I-Anaphylaxis ihlale iyisimo esiphuthumayo, ngisho noma izimpawu ziba ngcono ngemva kwe-EpiPen. Myise esibhedlela.
